notes.title: Lloyd the Monkey 2 v1.3 is Here!
notes.notes:
Happy Lunar New Year's, everybody! We apologize for holding this up, but [i]Lloyd the Monkey 2[/i] v1.3 is now available to download! This time, we decided to focus on accessibility improvements.

[list]
[*]We implemented mouse controls into all the menus.
[*]You can also pause the game with the left mouse button.
[*]The optional hub levels are now referred to as "base stages", hopefully better communicating their optionality.
[*]In addition, we fixed a minor glitch in the Castle base.
[/list]

We've timed this update to coincide with the Lunar New Year's sale, so [i]Lloyd the Monkey 2[/i] will also be 50% off from February 11-15. Enjoy!

notes.title: Lloyd the Monkey v1.2 is Here!
notes.notes:
With the Steam Autumn Sale about to kick off, we're excited to release [i]Lloyd the Monkey 2[/i] v1.2, with a new selection of changes to improve the gameplay experience!

[list]
[*]The partner AI will now attack enemies that get close enough.
[*]When your partner falls into a death field, they will respawn next to your character.
[*]Additional visuals have been added to the Southern River stage.
[/list]

To mark the occasion, the game will be available for [b]50% off[/b] for the duration of the Autumn Sale, with v1.2 being available for free for those who have already purchased it.

Check back for the Winter Sale for v1.3!

notes.title: Lloyd the Monkey 2 v1.1 Now Live!
notes.notes:
Thank you for purchasing Lloyd the Monkey 2! We appreciate your interest in the game.

It's been two months since the game launched, and we're excited to announce the first of several updates to the game culminating in the Winter Sale. This update fixes some minor playability issues found in the initial release:

[list]
[*]The prologue level cannot be softlocked now.
[*]A door was added to Byzantium Castle, reducing confusion on where to go at the beginning of the game.
[*]Additional audio is implemented into a endgame cutscene.
[/list]

We've got more improvements coming, so stay tuned!
